headline: Egypt Repays $38.2 Billion in External Debt as Foreign Reserves Reach Record High
summary: The Central Bank of Egypt reported paying $38.2 billion in external debt service during the 2025/2026 fiscal year while maintaining all-time high foreign currency reserves.
why: Egypt has faced severe foreign currency shortages in recent years; meeting large debt commitments while building reserves signals stabilizing external accounts.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Egypt demonstrated improved external debt sustainability by servicing $38.2 billion amid peak reserves.
